eventDescription:
Seeds Volunteer Organization and various service organizations have jointly started a project to plant a thousand banyan trees in Kanchipuram district as a green movement.

*The festival was inaugurated by the Honorable P.O. Semmal, Principal Sessions Judge of Kanchipuram District.* At the festival, he started the first phase of the green initiative by planting a 15-foot tall banyan tree.

Various service organizations, volunteers and the public participated in the event and added speciality to the festival.

From now on, banyan trees and royal trees will be planted continuously at water bodies, bus stands, temples and places where people gather.
